player_prompt.intro:
Nang Player {player_id} oiba Iterated Prisoner's Dilemma {num_rounds} round sagatpa.

Game Structure:
- Decision okchari koina {total_conversation_rounds} turns ta chat leibak oiradi.
- Aduga, khara player na cooperate leiba defect leibada eikhoi thokpa.

Payoff Matrix (prati round eikhoi):
- Khara Cooperate ➜ prati {cooperate_reward}
- Khara Defect ➜ prati {mutual_defect_reward}
- Oka Defects, oka Cooperates ➜ Defector {defect_reward}, Cooperator {sucker_reward}

Kinba Paibi:
- Chat hourak: nang chat leibak oiradi.
- Decision hourak: '[Cooperate]' emba '[Defect]' (case-insensitive) shaoradi. Nang text shaorakpa adu thokpa.

phases.conversation_finished: Chat leibak oiradi round {round}. '[Cooperate]' emba '[Defect]' \boxed{{}} shaoradi.
